newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lai Sun Dev interim net up 13.35 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lai Sun Dev interim net up 13.35 pct.

text.p: Company name Lai Sun Development Co Ltd
NOTE - Lai Sun Development, a 38.86 pct owned by Lai Sun Garment (International) Ltd, is engaged in investment holding and property development.

The accounting policy for hotel properties whereby such assets were stated at cost and the building portion was depreciated at 2.5 percent per annum on the straight-line basis in prior years was changed during the year ended July 31, 1996.

The directors consider that the new policy, whereby such assets are now carried at historical cost and not depreciated, is consistent with industry practice and will give a fairer presentation of the results and the financial position of the group.
In restating the results of the six months ended January 31, 1996, profit attributable to shareholders for that period has been increased by HK$9.16 million.
Certain comparative amounts have been reclassified to conform with the current period presentation.
The comparative share earnings and interim dividend have been adjusted for the share consolidation of five-into-one with effect from September 6, 1996.
